camera.reason: Single 8MP rear camera with no OIS and a 5MP selfie camera.

performance.reason: Unisoc T7100 on Android Go handles calls and WhatsApp but lags in heavier apps.

battery.reason: 5,000mAh lasts a full day, but 10W charging is slow.

display.reason: 6.6 inch HD+ LCD at 90Hz, rated 400 nits.

build.reason: Plastic body; itel claims MIL-STD-810H drop testing but lists no IP rating.

software.reason: Android 15 Go edition with no published OS update promise.

value.reason: At 29,000 it costs about the same as the 13MP nubia A36 and 6,000mAh Spark 40C while offering less.

availability.reason: In stock at PriceOye and listed by several Daraz sellers, with official itel warranty via Carlcare.

notes: Pakistan listings mix variant labels: PriceOye sells the 4GB 64GB at 28,999 (in stock) and lists a 2GB 64GB at 23,499 but out of stock on 2026-10-10. A separate A100C Special Edition 3GB 128GB is in stock at PriceOye for 25,999. Weight is from third-party sites (itel does not publish it).
